trip.title: A day on the west coast

experiences.title: Stay for the sunset
experiences.description: An unhurried evening on the lagoon. Watch the light change over the water, then take the long way back along the beach.
experiences.overview: A slower end to the day.
experiences.alt: A sailboat on the lagoon as the sun sets over the west coast
experiences.planIdea: Stay for the sunset on the west coast of Mauritius.

experiences.title: Take the scenic route
experiences.description: Follow the green heart of the island to Chamarel. Make time for the waterfall lookout, forest views and a relaxed lunch along the way.
experiences.alt: A waterfall cascading into a wooded gorge in Chamarel
experiences.planIdea: Visit the waterfall lookout in Chamarel, Mauritius.

experiences.title: A taste of the island
experiences.description: Get to know the island through its markets. Browse the stalls, meet local makers and leave room for something delicious.
experiences.alt: Fruit stalls and shoppers outside the market in Port Louis
experiences.planIdea: Explore the market in Port Louis, Mauritius.
